_comment: Apps that draw their own title bar (client-side decorations): they get no second bar with traffic lights from riptide-wm (hypr/modules/csd_apps.lua). own: window classes as `hyprctl clients` shows them, * = anything. main_only: apps where only the main window (its first title) draws its own bar – their other windows need ours to be closed. The user's choice per app wins over this: System Settings → Erscheinungsbild → Titelleisten (settings.json titlebars: {class: "app" | "ours"}).
